manifest.name: Open String Echo
manifest.author: Outside Dev
manifest.description: The mirror names an open string (G, D, A or E). Play it; the ring turns green when you are in tune.
manifest.howTo: Play the open string the mirror shows and hold it in tune for one second.

notes: Test package (R2b): a pretend third-party game built from the public docs, to test the Marketplace end to end.
